note: agent-decomposed 2026-09-22 (stasis round 3). Legs 1-2 implemented and evidenced (§8: 967158231, e6ad72cf0, c981229bf, c936435f7; golden CIDs pinned). Leg 3 (acceptance at ratification, adverse attestation), the concurrency-seam graduation and the ContributorPresence graduation path are design. The execution plan (plans/2026-08-15-actor-plane-implementation-plan) carries its own stations.

items.text: Leg 1: epr actor claim / current with ActorClaim atom (charset, claimed_at = HEAD author date, definition_cid, sidecar actors.jsonl, latest-wins, never blocks)
Leg 2a: epr flow note --as/--session three-arm attribution with steward:<email> slot; unflagged notes byte-identical (golden CID)
Leg 2b: epr govern --session actor stamp {claimed, session, definitionCid, source: claim|unclaimed}
Leg 2c: Co-Authored-By trailers lifted to sorted, deduplicated co-author:<normalized> classified_as slots on newly minted Produce events
Leg 3a: acceptance at dev-merge ratification as a graduated-rigor Witness station — recorded, not judged (fills commitment-dispatch-puller C9)
Leg 3b: adverse attestation via classifier §11.2 correction with an evidence CID; contest escalates the next acceptance to the Audit tier
Concurrency seam graduation: per-instance claims or subsession ids for concurrent runs of one persona (v1 mitigation = serialized persona rounds)
Graduation path: persistent agent identities -> ContributorPresence(unclaimed, steward=operator); co-authorship -> attestation:witnessed-ascription
Retro-attribution migration of trailers onto existing events as a deliberate separate migration (never a side-effect of re-projection)
Migration: normalize_co_author / producing_commit move into brit's commit-lift; register Co-Authored-By in brit's trailer key grammar
